name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.33: a public features page for prospects, linked from the login screen, plus a demo-request form that reaches us with their details. public/features.html is bilingual Icelandic and English with a toggle, defaults to Icelandic and deliberately does not browser-sniff (plenty of Icelandic operators run an English phone, so navigator.language would send most of the audience to the wrong language), remembers the choice per browser, and is built phone first in the dashboard's own tokens so the page and the product look like one thing. It describes only what is proven in production: fleet status, layout and products, sales and revenue, remote control, complaints, settlement and invoicing, the transaction-window reconciliation, alerts, roles, and the Nayax, Weimi and Payday integrations. Per-basket scale controls and fridge lighting are deliberately absent - the kiosk app answers set_led and the scale commands as unsupported today, and a sales page must not claim them. New POST /api/v1/demo-request is the only route a stranger can post to, so it is kept minimal: unauthenticated but with a honeypot, a per-IP and global rate limit, hard caps on every field, newline stripping, no database write, and a plain-text mail with nothing rendered as markup. The advertised 'password demo' hint is removed from the login card: prospects should ask for a demo account so their details arrive with the request rather than letting themselves in anonymously. Cumulative over v6.32.3.
